This recipe is originally by Chef Taylor Piercefield.

==Ingredients==

* ½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (2 sticks) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], divided
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]], divided
* 12 cups [[Cookbook:Stock|beef stock]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] extra-virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 4 cups [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] [[Cookbook:Portobello Mushroom|portobello mushrooms]]
* 4 cups sliced [[Cookbook:Shiitake|shiitakes]]
* 4 cups [[Cookbook:Button Mushroom|button mushrooms]], sliced if large
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Wine|sherry]]

==Procedure==

# In a large pot over medium heat, melt one stick of the butter.
# Add ½ cup of the flour, stirring constantly, to form a [[Cookbook:Roux|roux]].
# Cook, continuing to stir constantly, until roux takes on a pale blond color, about 5 minutes.
# Slowly stir in the beef stock.
# Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], stirring frequently.
# Reduce heat to a [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]].
# In a large [[Cookbook:saucepan|saucepan]] over medium-high heat, melt the remaining stick of butter with the olive oil.
# Add the portobellos, shiitakes, and button mushrooms and [[Cookbook:Sauté|sauté]] until mushrooms are moist and tender, 5–10 minutes.
# Remove pan from heat and dust mushrooms with the remaining ½ cup of flour, [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|tossing]] gently to incorporate flour.
# Combine mushrooms and beef stock in the large pot.
# Stir in the sherry.
# Cook, stirring occasionally, until flavors are melded and soup thickened slightly, about 10 minutes.
# Serve hot.
